description: An export of a recording: either ready, with its download link, or running, with the url to poll.

exportId.description: Identifies a running export. Absent when the export was ready at once.

type.description: The type that was requested. Present in the answer to the request.

status.description: `pending`: queued. `in_progress`: being rendered. `done`: ready, see `downloadUrl`. `failed`: stopped, see `errorMessage`.

downloadUrl.description: Signed link to the file, valid for three hours. Only when `status` is `done`.

statusUrl.description: Path to poll with `GET` and the same credentials until `status` is `done` or `failed`.

errorMessage.description: Why the export failed. Only when `status` is `failed`.
